QF.id: IV Fixed Income Instruments and Bond Markets_7

question.text: A bond has a Modified Duration of 5.11 and a dirty price of Rs. 100.60. What is the PV01 (Price Value of a Basis Point)?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the source, PV01 = Dirty Price × Modified Duration / 10000 = 100.60 × 5.11 / 10000 = 0.0514, which is approximately Rs. 0.051. The Trap: Rs. 0.514 is 10x too large (dividing by 1000 instead of 10000), and Rs. 5.14 confuses a percentage with an absolute price change. The 10000 divisor is essential. Note: PV01 measures the rupee price change for a 1 basis point change in yield.
